newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec says doesn't think it made illegal deals.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec says doesn't think it made illegal deals.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it does not think it conducted any illegal deals with corporate racketeers as reported by the media.
"We do not think at the moment that there were any illegal deals," said a company spokesman.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday that Nikko, one of Japan's four biggest brokerages, is suspected of conducting illegal discretionary trading on behalf of "sokaiya" racketeer Ryuichi Koike.
Koike has been indicted by prosecutors in a scandal embroiling Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd.

On Wednesday, officials of the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission and prosecutors office raided another "Big Four" brokerage, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, to search for evidence of payoffs.
